name: 失眠严重程度指数
instructions: 以下问题涉及您最近的睡眠情况。请根据过去两周的实际情况作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your recent sleep. Please answer according to what actually happened over the past two weeks.
license: Morin 编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 您入睡困难的严重程度如何？
items.textEn: How severe were your difficulties falling asleep?

items.text: 您维持睡眠困难的严重程度如何？
items.textEn: How severe were your difficulties staying asleep?

items.text: 您早醒问题的严重程度如何？
items.textEn: How severe was your problem with early morning awakenings?

items.text: 您对目前睡眠模式的满意程度如何？
items.textEn: How satisfied were you with your current sleep pattern?

items.text: 您的睡眠问题对您日常功能的影响程度如何？
items.textEn: How much did your sleep problems interfere with your daily functioning?

items.text: 您认为您的睡眠问题在多大程度上影响了您的生活质量？
items.textEn: To what extent have your sleep problems affected your quality of life?

items.text: 您对目前睡眠问题的担忧程度如何？
items.textEn: How worried were you about your current sleep problems?

totalBands.description: 总分低于8，未达到临床失眠标准。
总分8-15，存在轻度睡眠问题，建议关注睡眠卫生。
总分15-22，存在中度失眠症状，建议寻求专业评估。
总分22及以上，存在重度失眠症状，建议尽快寻求专业帮助。
